{{Top}}
'''Rep''' was the title given to [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] officials who sat on the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

The Reps were distinguished by their tall hoods and long, patterned robes similar in appearance to those worn by the [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] of Otoh Gunga. Each Rep was responsible for a different aspect of the Gungan government, from maintaining historical records to overseeing the city's power supplies.
